description: This header defines the API and data structures for sampling hashtables and collecting runtime statistics within the Abseil C++ library, including classes, functions, and macros related to hashtable sampling and profiling.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Stores runtime profiling information about a sampled hashtable, including capacity, size, probe lengths, and hash bitwise operations, with thread-safe mutation and sampling preparation.

classes.name: HashtablezInfoHandle
classes.description: RAII handle managing registration and deregistration of hashtable samples, with conditional compilation for sampling enabled or disabled.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records a slow rehash event with total probe length.

methods.name: RecordReservationSlow
methods.description: Records a slow reservation event with target capacity.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Records a change in storage size and capacity.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records a slow insert event with hash and distance from desired position.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Returns a sampling handle that manages registration with the global sampler, conditioned on sampling flags.
